name: 🇦🇺Better Country?!🇺🇸
desc:
Silly little game i made for fun, don't take it too seriously. - I am unsure what to add next, please feel free to suggest things in feedback.

🇧🇷🇺🇸🇨🇦 Welcome to Better Country! 🇦🇺🇰🇷🇨🇳

⭐👍 LIKE and FAVORITE the game for new updates! 👍⭐

🎮🌎 Game Rules
⭐️🌍Choose 1 Country that has been selected!
🗡️🌏Fight for your country choice with weapons!
🏆🌐Successfully defend your country choice and bring the country a win for your team!

⚠️ Better country is not intended to be political or represent real life conflicts in any way, it is intended to be a geography game. ⚠️

Inspired by better music, better movie and better kpop!
